title: Claim Type
governance_note: Classify outputs as exploratory, predictive, explanatory, causal, or decision-supporting.

title: Approximation Boundary
governance_note: Define what the model preserves and what it simplifies.

title: Uncertainty Sources
governance_note: Separate data, model, numerical, sampling, and interpretive uncertainty.

governance_note: Record where the model has been checked and where it has not.

title: Responsible Use
governance_note: Keep computation, evidence, interpretation, and governance connected.
